profile.headline: Software Engineer at Puppet by Perforce

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on Continuous Delivery for Puppet Enterprise writing Java, Javascript and Puppet.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked mainly with the Pipelines organization where I began engineering primarily in Java and Javascript (React). Regularly demoed work for my team and the engineering org. Delivered several projects on Docker, some in Kubernetes, that used a Java backend, PostgreSQL, and a React frontend.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of the Modules team, assisted in maintenance of Puppet’s 41 supported modules (written in Puppet and Ruby). Became a member of Vox Pupuli and collaborated with the Puppet community on GitHub, IRC, and Slack as well as weekly open source triage meetings.
● Internationalization of Puppet modules:
○ developed the puppetlabs-translate module
○ contributed to Puppet core’s support of log/stdout localization for modules
● puppet-strings
○ Added markdown generation and support for Puppet tasks and plans
○ Released version 2.0.0 with blog post

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description: Built browser automation for Columbia, Mountain Hardwear, Sorel, Prana, and Montrail eCommerce sites using Nightwatch.js and Coffeescript. Also built tools for QA using Nodejs. Collaborated with marketing, product, and UX groups to discern requirements for the customer shopping experience and executed both manual and automated test suites across a range of browsers and devices.

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description:
- Wrote and executed test cases in an Agile environment using TestLink and JIRA
- Automated tests using Java with Selenium and REST-Assured
- Maintained test environment with 2 Ubuntu servers running JBoss 7 and MySQL

positions.title: Associate Desktop Technician
positions.description: I support 230+ end users over multiple platforms (Windows, Mac OS, Linux). Duties include building and deploying laptop images, managing the laptop inventory in a predominantly Lenovo shop (with the Dell KACE system), managing Active Directory (Server 2008 R2), managing the office print server (Windows 2008 R2), supporting Microsoft Office (including Visio and Project), internet browsers, the Cisco VPN clent, Sophos Endpoint Control, Crashplan Backup, and several Adobe products. I also work with troubleshooting internet and VPN connections, kernel errors, and bad hardware.

positions.title: Desktop Support Intern
positions.description: Supported 150+ end users over multiple platforms (Windows, Mac OS, Linux). Duties included building and deploying laptop images, managing the laptop inventory in a predominantly Dell shop, supporting Microsoft Office (including Visio and Project), internet browsers, the Cisco VPN clent, Sophos Endpoint Control, Crashplan Backup, and several Adobe products. I also worked with troubleshooting internet and VPN connections, kernel errors, and bad hardware. Later on, my duties expanded to include support of the GetWellNetwork product demos which are Linux-based.
